keyword.zh: 搅拌泵400和500搅拌机说明是什么

title.en: What the 400 and 500 Mixer Note Says

description.en: Both mixer pumps mention a 400 mixer on the 30 series and a 500 mixer on the 40/50 series. The note does not add a second full spec table.
description.zh: 两台搅拌泵都写到30系列配400搅拌机、40/50系列配500搅拌机。这条说明没有再附一套完整规格表。

h1.en: What the 400 and 500 Mixer Note Says

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery prints a series note on both mixer concrete pumps in Xingtai. The electric integrated mixer says 30 series with 400 mixer; 40/50 series with 500 mixer. The diesel mixer says 30 model with 400 mixer; 40/50 model with 500 mixer. The note does not reprint output, pressure or distance for each series. The electric page still has one output, 21 m³/h. The diesel page still has one output, 25 m³/h.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台的两台搅拌混凝土泵上都印了系列说明。电动一体机写：30系列配400搅拌机；40/50系列配500搅拌机。柴油搅拌泵写：30型配400搅拌机；40/50型配500搅拌机。这条说明没有为每个系列重印产量、压力或距离。电动页仍是一个产量 21 m³/h。柴油页仍是一个产量 25 m³/h。不要编造两套隐藏的表。

body.en: The electric page prints 45 kW / 14 kW, 23 MPa, distance 100 m / 300 m and aggregate 4 cm and below. The diesel page prints 4108 / 66–75 kW, 23 MPa and three stone rows. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not duplicate those blocks under a 400 heading and again under a 500 heading.
body.zh: 电动页印 45 kW / 14 kW、23 MPa、距离 100 m / 300 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下。柴油页印 4108 / 66–75 kW、23 MPa 和三行石子距离。河北品锦机械没有在 400 标题下和 500 标题下各复制一块这些参数。

heading.en: What the note does not number

body.en: The words 400 and 500 are not given a unit on the sheet. The note does not say they are litres, millimetres or kilograms. Leave the unit unstated rather than inventing one.
body.zh: 400 和 500 在参数页上没有给出单位。说明没有说它们是升、毫米或千克。单位没有写出来，就不要编一个。

body.en: Both pages are mixer pumps that mix and pump on one trailer. They are not mixing plants. The category is /en/products/mixer-pumps/.
body.zh: 两页都是在同一拖车上搅拌并泵送的搅拌泵。它们不是搅拌站。分类是 /zh/products/mixer-pumps/。

question.en: Does the 500 mixer have its own m³/h?
question.zh: 500搅拌机有自己的 m³/h 吗？

answer.en: No separate output is printed. The electric page shows 21 m³/h once. The diesel page shows 25 m³/h once.
answer.zh: 没有单独的产量。电动页只显示一次 21 m³/h。柴油页只显示一次 25 m³/h。

answer.en: The series note does not print a unit.
The integrated mixer pump and the diesel mixer integrated pump.
answer.zh: 搅拌泵一体机和柴油搅拌泵一体机。

question.en: Is this a mixing plant table?

answer.en: No. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not list a mixing plant. These are mixer pumps.
answer.zh: 不是。河北品锦机械没有列出搅拌站。这些是搅拌泵。
